summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is from a horoscope application. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Header Section**:
   - Title: "General Horoscopes"
   - Date: "Thu, December 15, 2016"
   - Zodiac Sign: "Aries"
   - Navigation buttons: "Main" and "Back"

2. **Tabs for Horoscope Types**:
   - Options to view horoscopes by different time frames: "Daily," "Weekly," "Monthly"
   - Option to get a "Free Astro Profile"

3. **Main Content**:
   - Title: "Free astro profile by email"
   - Description: Prompts users to get a free astrological profile by entering their email address. It mentions that the profile will provide insights into their personality, strengths, and weaknesses.
   - Input Field: A text box to enter the email address.
   - Button: "Continue" to proceed with the email submission.
